bio: In four 16th-century tenement houses in the city’s Old Town lies the luxury H15 Palace Hotel; within it sits this smart, contemporary restaurant with a glass roof, tropical plants and bright modern artwork. Choose from two tersely worded tasting menus that use seasonal produce in reinventions of historical Polish recipes. Precise presentation, bold flavours and creativity help to make each dish a success. Engaging service and a hint of theatre add to the overall enjoyment....
